---
name: Bug Report
about: Create a report to help us improve Impacket-RS
title: '[BUG] '
labels: 'bug'
assignees: 'nestho'
---

## Description
A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Tool & Command Executed
Which subcommand was invoked (e.g., `secretsdump`, `smbclient`, `ntlmrelayx`) and exact command syntax (redact passwords/hashes):
```bash
impacket-rs <tool> [options] <target>
```

## Environment
- **Impacket-RS Version**: (e.g. `v0.2.1` or commit hash)
- **Target OS**: (e.g. Windows Server 2022, Windows 10, Samba 4.19)
- **Client OS**: (e.g. Linux x86_64, macOS ARM64, Windows)
- **Rust Toolchain**: `rustc --version` (if built from source)

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Output / Error
Command output with error messages or stack traces:
```text
[-] Error output here...
```

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. network captures, domain configuration, Kerberos vs NTLM).
